sources.note: Cited by Roberts 2025 as his sole Heɗe source: a 445-verb corpus, 'focuses on the phonology and morphology of the verbal system'; the verb forms Roberts reproduces from it are fully tone-marked (e.g. pà 'love', kēɓ 'look for', sɨ̄ɗā 'grow', kɨ̀ràk 'trim'), so the mémoire records lexical/grammatical verb tone and very likely states the tone inventory; not seen (unpublished N'Djaména mémoire; a copy is evidently held by J. Roberts / SIL Chad).
